# FringeIsland — Architecture Baseline

**Date of Analysis:** 2026-03-14
**Version:** v0.2.36 (Ferd)
**Generated by:** Claude Code reading the live repository
**Structure:** Mapped to [ARCHITECTURE_ANATOMY.md](../../../old_universe/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_ANATOMY.md) layers L0–L7, verticals, and Platform API ring

---

## How to Read This Document

This baseline maps every implemented artifact in the Ferd codebase to the anatomy defined in `ARCHITECTURE_ANATOMY.md`. For each layer and vertical:

- **Implemented** — working code, tested, in production
- **Placeholder** — anatomy element exists in the spec but is not yet built
- **Deferred** — deliberately excluded per [`DEFERRED.md`](../../../old_products/ferd/planning/DEFERRED.md)

The [Ferd Completion Summary](#ferd-completion-summary) at the end provides a per-layer overview.

---

## L0 — Infrastructure

*The ground. Everything else depends on this.*

### Implemented

| Element | Implementation | Details |
|---------|---------------|---------|
| **Supabase** | Managed backend | PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Realtime |
| **PostgreSQL** | 19 tables | All with RLS enabled. D15 Universal Group Pattern rebuild (migration `20260222000000`) |
| **Auth** | Supabase Auth | Email/password, session management via `proxy.ts` (Next.js 16 pattern) |
| **RLS** | 51+ policies | Enforced on all 19 tables. `is_platform_admin()` SECURITY DEFINER for admin checks |
| **Storage** | Supabase Storage | Avatar uploads (`AvatarUpload.tsx`), group avatars |
| **Realtime** | Supabase Realtime | Used for notifications (`NotificationContext.tsx`), DM delivery, forum updates |

**Database tables (19):**

| # | Table | Anatomy layer | Purpose |
|---|-------|--------------|---------|
| 1 | `users` | L1 Identity | Auth bridge — links auth.users to public profile |
| 2 | `groups` | L2 Organisation | All groups: system, personal, engagement |
| 3 | `group_memberships` | L2 Organisation | Group-joins-group membership records |
| 4 | `permissions` | L2 Organisation | Permission catalog (31 named permissions, 7 categories) |
| 5 | `role_templates` | L2 Organisation | System role templates (Steward, Guide, Member, Observer) |
| 6 | `group_templates` | L2 Organisation | Templates for group creation |
| 7 | `group_roles` | L2 Organisation | Role instances within specific groups |
| 8 | `group_role_permissions` | L2 Organisation | Permissions assigned to group role instances |
| 9 | `user_group_roles` | L2 Organisation | User role assignments within groups |
| 10 | `role_template_permissions` | L2 Organisation | Template-to-permission mappings |
| 11 | `group_template_roles` | L2 Organisation | Template-to-role mappings |
| 12 | `journeys` | L3 Experience | Learning journey definitions (8 predefined) |
| 13 | `journey_enrollments` | L3 Experience | Group/user enrollment in journeys |
| 14 | `notifications` | V: Notifications | In-app notifications (7 types, passive + actionable) |
| 15 | `forum_posts` | L5 Communication | Group forum posts (flat threading enforced) |
| 16 | `conversations` | L5 Communication | DM conversation headers (2 participants) |
| 17 | `direct_messages` | L5 Communication | Individual DM messages |
| 18 | `admin_audit_log` | V: Observability | Immutable audit trail for admin actions |
| 19 | `pending_email_invitations` | L2 Organisation | Pre-signup email invitations pending claim |

## L2 — Organisation

*How are people structured?*

### Implemented

| Element | Implementation | Details |
|---------|---------------|---------|
| **Groups** | `groups` table | 3 types: system, personal, engagement. No hardcoded types (ADR-018) |
| **Universal Group Pattern** | D15 rebuild | Personal groups auto-created; groups join groups (ADR-006/019) |
| **Memberships** | `group_memberships` table | `member_group_id` only (no `user_id`). Statuses: active, invited, paused, removed |
| **Roles** | 3-layer model (ADR-007) | Templates → Group roles → User assignments |
| **Permissions** | 31 atomic permissions | 7 categories. `has_permission()` runtime check |
| **DeusEx** | System super-admin group | `is_platform_admin()` SECURITY DEFINER. Last-member guards |
| **System groups** | FI Members, Visitor, DeusEx | Created by D15 rebuild migration |
| **Invitation workflow** | Invite → accept/decline | RLS policies + notification triggers |
| **Leave/remove workflow** | Member leave, Steward remove, admin exit | Last-leader guard trigger |
| **Steward nomination** | `nominate_steward()` RPC | Sole Steward nominates successor before leaving |

## Platform API Ring

*The contract between the backend and every frontend.*

### Implemented API Routes

| Route | Method | Purpose | Anatomy layer |
|-------|--------|---------|--------------|
| `/api/admin/users` | GET | Paginated/searchable admin user list; uses service_role to bypass RLS | V: Administration |
| `/api/invitations/send-email` | POST | Sends simulated invitation email; validates `invite_members` permission | L2 Organisation |

### Current Pattern

The Ferd codebase primarily uses the **Supabase client (PostgREST)** for data access — browser client calls Supabase directly, with RLS enforcing security. Only 2 Next.js API routes exist, both for operations requiring `service_role` (bypassing RLS for admin operations).

**Gap vs. anatomy:** The anatomy specifies an API-first pattern (ADR-009) where all functionality goes through `/api/...` routes, making the backend frontend-agnostic. The current Ferd pattern of direct Supabase client calls from the browser works but creates tight coupling that would need refactoring before iOS/Android clients connect.

### Placeholder

| Element | Anatomy reference | Notes |
|---------|------------------|-------|
| **API versioning** | ADR-015 | No `/api/v1/` prefix on existing routes |
| **Rate limiting** | Platform API ring | No rate limiting on API routes |
| **Authentication middleware** | Platform API ring | JWT validation happens via Supabase client, not API middleware |
| **Extension surface** | Platform API ring | Plugin connection points — wave TBD, pending work package redistribution (see WAVE_REDISTRIBUTION.md) |

## Ferd Completion Summary

| Layer / Vertical | Status | Implemented | Placeholder | Key gap |
|-----------------|--------|-------------|-------------|---------|
| **L0 Infrastructure** | Solid | Supabase, PostgreSQL, Auth, RLS, Storage, Realtime | Feature flags, i18n, email service, AI provider, pg_cron | Feature flags needed for Ferd→next-wave transition |
| **L1 Identity** | Mostly complete | Permanent identity, profiles, display names, sessions | Visitor/shadow, profile_data table | Visitor experience blocks L3 Journey Zero |
| **L2 Organisation** | Complete | Groups, memberships, RBAC (31 perms, 4 roles), DeusEx, invitation/leave/nomination | Circularity trigger (D11), groups-join-groups UI | D11 must ship before group-joins-group UI |
| **L3 Experience** | Partial | Journey catalogue, enrolments, progress, player UI | Journey designer, step types, Journey Zero | **Linchpin** — step type spec session needed |
| **L4 Content** | Minimal | Journey JSONB content, avatar media | Reflections, assessments, journal, rich media, i18n | Blocked by L3 step type spec + L1 profile_data |
| **L5 Communication** | Mostly complete | DM, forums (flat threading), forum anonymisation | Announcements, activity feed | Announcements needed for Steward→group messaging |
| **L6 Discovery** | Minimal | Basic journey listing, user search | Full-text search, recommendations, marketplace | Blocked by L3 spec + community scale |
| **L7 Intelligence** | Not started | — | AI Mentor, profile accumulation, insights | Correctly empty — depends on all lower layers |
| **V: Administration** | Strong | User lifecycle (soft/hard delete, decommission, exit), DeusEx, audit | Content moderation, group archive, reactivation | Content moderation needed for Hamn (wave TBD) |
| **V: Privacy** | Minimal | RLS enforcement, display name privacy | GDPR rights, consent, data map, AI handling | Needs dedicated work before public launch |
| **V: Notifications** | Strong | 7 types, Realtime, actionable, bell UI | Email delivery, push, preferences | Email service is Ferd 1.6 priority |
| **V: Observability** | Partial | Admin audit log | Structured logs, metrics, error tracking | Sentry is Ferd 1.6 priority |
| **V: Transactions** | Not started | — | Stripe Connect, subscriptions, marketplace | Correctly empty for Ferd |
| **Platform API** | Thin | 2 API routes (admin) | API-first pattern, versioning, rate limiting | Major gap — direct Supabase calls need API wrapping |
| **Design System** | Informal | Tailwind, 2 UI components | Formal system, i18n, a11y, world aesthetic | i18n/a11y are ADR-013 constraints |
